page.title: Overview
page.description: Running experiments, recent changes and SDK traffic.
page.descriptionIn: Running experiments, recent changes and SDK traffic in {{name}}.

onboarding.title: Get started
onboarding.description: Ship a change behind a flag, measure it, and let an experiment tell you whether to keep it.

flag.title: Create a flag
flag.description: A flag wraps the code you want to change. Start with an on/off flag around one new behavior.

sdk.title: Install the SDK
sdk.description: Add @furca/sdk to your app with the {{name}} key. It downloads one payload and evaluates flags locally, with no request per check.
sdk.otherRuntimes: Cloudflare Workers, Node and other environments

metric.title: Send events and define a metric
metric.description: Call {{call}} where the outcome happens, then turn that event into a metric like "share of users who purchased".
metric.descriptionWithEvents: Call {{call}} where the outcome happens, then turn that event into a metric like "share of users who purchased". Received so far: {{names}}.

experiment.title: Start an experiment
experiment.description: Pick the flag, a primary metric and the traffic split. furca assigns users deterministically and tells you when the result is real.

traffic.title: SDK traffic
traffic.description: Exposures and tracked events per hour in {{name}}, last 24 hours.
traffic.emptyTitle: No SDK traffic in {{name}} in the last 24 hours
traffic.emptyDescription: Exposures arrive when a user is bucketed into a running experiment; events when your app calls track().
traffic.tableCaption: Hourly SDK traffic in {{name}}, last 24 hours

running.title: Running experiments
running.description: Live verdict on each primary metric, from the latest analysis.
running.empty: Nothing is running. <action>Create an experiment</action> to test a change on real users; its verdict will show up here.
